title: Evaluation of bias correction methods in improving the direct model output of temperature in CMIP over Iran
authors: Dina Yazdani, Azar Zarrin, Abbas Ali Dadashi-Roudbari
journal: Journal of the Earth and Space Physics
abstract: This study evaluated five bias correction methods for minimum and maximum temperature simulations from the EC-Earth3-CC model across 46 synoptic stations in Iran during 1980–2014. The results showed that all methods substantially reduced model biases and errors, improving agreement with observations. However, no single method performed best across all regions, highlighting the importance of considering local climate and geographical conditions when selecting a bias correction approach.
